_what: Ground truth for correctness-screen.ts: the 81 FoodMapping rows that warm batch 01 ADDED, each joined to the OffFood/FatSecretFood record behind it, and each hand-graded GOOD / SUSPECT / BAD by a human audit. This is the fixture the pinned Tier-D confusion matrix in correctness-screen.test.ts is measured against.
_whyItMatters: Batch 01 passed every structural gate (0 eval failures, 0% ai_estimated, added 81 / changed 0 / removed 0) and 27.2% of these rows are wrong. The gates certify that a batch did no damage; they say nothing about whether what it wrote is correct. Do not re-grade a row here to make a rule pass — an honest lower number is the correct outcome of a refactor, a fudged label is not.

_provenance.rowPull: read-only SELECT (correctness-screen.ts ROW_SQL) against the production box 192.168.1.133 at master 751d6a39; all 81 rows re-pulled at the end of that session and 0 of 81 had changed
_provenance.labels: hand audit, 2026-07-25 (investigations/labels-batch01.json + labels-batch01.md in the mobile repo's sync-docs/warm-plan-2026-07-25/). 23 BAD / 10 SUSPECT / 48 GOOD. An earlier independent pass of the same batch graded 22/12/47 — the labels are a human judgement, so 100% recall against THIS labelling is not 100% recall against the truth.
_provenance.seed: the batch seed each key was attributed back to. correctness-screen.ts attribute() reproduces all 81 of these exactly, both with canonicalizeCacheKey (69 exact + 12 stem-Jaccard) and without it (81 stem-Jaccard), so the fixture pins the seed directly and the test needs no DB.
